info.title: QA Arena API
info.description: Practice shop API for the QA Automation course. Sessions: cookie arena_session (header X-Arena-Session outside the hosted Arena).

get.summary: State of the caller's session (scenario, release, seed, UI flags). Does not create a session

put.summary: Activate a scenario on the caller's session (creating it). A new scenario or rngSeed resets the data; only a new release keeps it

post.summary: Reset ONLY the caller's session data and counters to its scenario's seed, keeping scenario, release and rng seed (header X-Arena-Session or cookie). Other sessions are untouched.

get.summary: Requirements document of the effective release (never includes the answer key)

put.summary: Set the assistant mode for this session (normal or faulty) and which faults apply

post.summary: Shopping assistant chat (deterministic stub by default; LLM if ASSISTANT_API_KEY is set)
Create a customer account and return a token
Log in with email and password

get.summary: List active products (search, filter, sort, paginate)

post.summary: Add units of a product (adds to the existing quantity)

patch.summary: Set the quantity of a line (0 removes it)

post.summary: Apply a coupon (idempotent: re-applying the same code changes nothing)
Pay the cart with a simulated card. 201 if approved, 402 if declined.
Mark one of my notifications as read

get.summary: All products including inactive, with stock

post.summary: Create a product with initial stock

put.summary: Set the stock of a product
